description: Fix the countdown timer timezone bug on booking show page, and make the booking/session/clinic detail pages fully responsive. The countdown bug: the server computes minutesUntil using PHP Carbon diffInMinutes which is timezone-naive on the client side — a user in a different timezone sees e.g. '3 hrs 55 min' instead of '30 min'. Fix: pass sessionStart as a UTC ISO 8601 string and compute the diff client-side. Also fix the booking page two-column layout collapse and session code font overflow. Independent of FEAT-001/002/003.
steps: READ context.json and this FEAT file first.

COUNTDOWN BUG — resources/views/pages/bookings/show.blade.php: Read the file fully to find the countdown <script> block. It will contain a variable initialized from PHP like: const minutesUntil = {{ $minutesUntil }} or let secondsLeft = {{ $minutesUntil * 60 }} or similar. Change it to compute from a UTC ISO string: replace the PHP-emitted seconds/minutes value with: const sessionStartUTC = new Date('{{ $sessionStart->toIso8601String() }}'); let secondsLeft = Math.max(0, Math.floor((sessionStartUTC - Date.now()) / 1000)); Keep the rest of the countdown interval logic (the setInterval, the hours/minutes/seconds display) exactly as-is — only replace the initialization of the seconds value.

BOOKING PAGE LAYOUT — resources/views/pages/bookings/show.blade.php: (1) Find the .session-grid main content container. Confirm it has grid-template-columns:1fr as the base. If a desktop 2-column rule exists only as inline style, move it to a <style> block: .session-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:24px;} @media(min-width:1024px){.session-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 380px;}} (2) Find .code-text (font-size:40px). Append to <style>: @media(max-width:400px){.code-text{font-size:26px;letter-spacing:.06em;}} (3) In the hero, the right-side session-ID box uses flex-shrink:0 — on narrow screens, add min-width:0 to the title div so it can shrink: find the title div and add ;min-width:0 to its inline style.

EXAMINER CLINIC DETAILS — resources/views/pages/examiner-clinic-details.blade.php: Read the file. Find #clinic-detail-bookings-table. Count its <th> columns. Find @empty block. Add the colspan empty row. Also check for any fixed-width stat grids and add responsive overrides using the same pattern as FEAT-003.

TUTOR DASHBOARD DataTables — resources/views/pages/dashboard/tutor.blade.php: Read the file. Find all DataTable @empty blocks (for session history, payouts tables). Add colspan empty rows. Also find the bookings tab stat grid that uses grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr) (the All/Upcoming/Completed/Cancelled summary row). Add class booking-summary-g. Append: .booking-summary-g{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)!important;} @media(min-width:768px){.booking-summary-g{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr)!important;}}
Commit all changes with message: 'fix(booking): countdown timezone; responsive booking/clinic/tutor-dashboard layout'
acceptance_criteria: A session booked for 30 minutes from now shows approximately '30:00' in the countdown, not 3h55m or any other wrong value, regardless of client browser timezone
The booking show page renders in single-column below 1024px with no horizontal overflow
The session code on booking show page is fully readable at 320px (does not overflow its box)
Tutor dashboard opens without horizontal overflow at 375px; booking summary stat grid shows 2×2 on mobile
verification: Create a test booking scheduled 30 minutes from now → open /sessions/{uuid} → countdown reads ~30:00 and counts down in real time
Chrome DevTools → 375px → open any booking show page → confirm single-column layout, no overflow
Chrome DevTools → 320px → open booking show page with a session code → code text visible without overflow
Chrome DevTools → 375px → open tutor dashboard bookings tab → summary grid shows 2 columns
